UPDATE style_packs sp SET is_deleted=TRUE, delete_time=NOW(), update_time=NOW() WHERE sp.id = (SELECT style_pack_id FROM novels WHERE id=#{novelId}) AND sp.is_preset = FALSE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM novels n WHERE n.style_pack_id = sp.id AND n.is_deleted = FALSE)
